detail: Both corpus texts ingested from .txt with `lc ingest` and indexed with `lc anchor` (doc-control segment over the converted .docx, novel profile plus its per-format settings: chapter_blank_lines 2 for .txt, chapter_level auto for .md; work language); detected chapter starts compared with the gold heading lines in tests/fixtures/gold/chapters.json. convert._txt_headings still writes plain text's heading convention as Heading 1: with chapter_blank_lines alone Marianela scores 0.977 (21/22), because '-XIV-' has a 9-word title line right under it and hard-wrapped text writes no empty paragraph for a single blank line, so doc-control sees no blank below the numeral. scene_boundary_f1 over the nine variants of tests/test_anchor.py stays 1.0 (the Markdown variants use '##' chapters again, through chapter_level auto).
